description: A target's SLA contract (guaranteed uptime per UTC calendar month, whether DEGRADED counts as down, optional p95 response objective) and its error budget: allowed and used downtime minutes, budget used %, attainment %, burn rate (1 = on pace to use exactly the budget), when the budget runs out at the current rate, and coverage. UNKNOWN checks and unmonitored time never count as downtime; maintenance windows are outside the contract. `sla` is null when the target has no contract.

months.description: Months of history including the current one (default 6)

name: get_target_sla
title: Get Target SLA
